parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query.

- If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the **NextToken** value returned from the last API call.

parameters.name: TrafficMarkingPolicyDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the traffic marking policy.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

parameters.name: TrafficMarkingPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the traffic marking policy.

parameters.name: TrafficMarkingPolicyName
parameters.description:
The name of the traffic marking policy.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

parameters.name: TransitRouterId
parameters.description: The ID of the TransitRouter instance.
